Description: Compound × kinase table with the experimental value, the binary label, and the direction-corrected prediction. This is the primary reproduction file: every per-drug, per-target, and global metric in the paper is computed from it.

Kinase_ref compound × kinase panel listing over 403 unique kinases, with the source series, panel size, profiling platform, citation, measurement unit, value, label, pool membership, and a flag distinguishing values released by the source paper from panel entries reconstructed as described in Methods S2.
Per-compound per-drug ROC with Hanley–McNeil 95% confidence intervals and active counts for both panels; the source of Table S1 and of Table S11.
Complete per-target metrics and the ligand-independent target preference against PDBbind training frequency for all 618 pool entries; the source of Table S4.
Every UniProt entry reachable from the experimental panels, flagged for presence in the experiment, in the prediction pool, and in the merged analysis, with the reason for any exclusion.
Raw per-pair prediction output before merging, for all four scoring functions.

kinome_merge.py (single source of the KIR merge, including composite-accession normalization), novel_cohort.py (leakage-free cohort definition; NOVEL_ONLY=0 reproduces the full cohort), ref_families.py and ref_panel_eval.py (Kinase_ref provenance and panel-restricted evaluation), plus the per-analysis scripts named in the main-text Data and code availability statement.

Structure-to-protein mapping for the whole reverse-docking target library: structure identifier, UniProt accession, gene symbol and protein name for each of the 618 kinase structures, so that any ranking position can be traced to a named protein (Methods S1).
